scope: PlannerOverlay commit-time registration and current close callback. Shared useModalSheet and trip-editor source files were not changed.
trigger: A dialog can commit before its passive effects register the modal layer and update the close callback. Close and Escape require registration; an updated guard must match the committed controls.
evidence: Three deterministic Profiler commit-boundary cases fail before the change: first click and Escape do not call onClose; changing onClose can invoke the previous callback.
The first click and Escape cases each cover initial mount, close, and reopening, and check the scroll lock before input.
Moved only the callback-ref update and layer/listener registration effects to useLayoutEffect. The theme observer remains passive.
The earlier task's after-flushSync probe is not contradicted: that probe reads after passive effects have been flushed; these tests deliver input during commit.
No waitFor relaxation, skip, timeout increase, test configuration change, shared modal-sheet change or trip-editor edit was introduced.

sources.supports: Passive effects can run after paint.
Layout effects run before browser repaint.

additional_diagnostic.reason: Whole-suite progress had not appeared after its previous 796-second duration; ran the previously failing consumer file to distinguish a consumer regression from a slow complete run.
additional_diagnostic.warnings: React act warnings from asynchronous updates in the existing offline-day and route-reorder cases; no assertion failures.
additional_diagnostic.load_observation: One Windows OS sample during the concurrent diagnostic reported 127108 KiB free of 16364204 KiB physical memory. This can affect timing but does not prove the reason for delayed whole-suite output.

whole_frontend.termination: Stopped only verified workspace Vitest PID 7436 after 19 minutes 34 seconds without any per-file result. The outer loop exited and did not start repetitions 2 or 3. The nonzero exit is operator interruption, not evidence of a failed test assertion.
whole_frontend.diagnosis: Cause of non-completion unconfirmed. Low memory was observed, but no per-file progress or assertion result was emitted. Preserve the incomplete result; do not treat it as a passed complete suite.
whole_frontend.next_step: When adequate local resources are available, run the complete suite with live verbose reporting to identify its last collected/executed case. Complete three consecutive full passes before closing the original flake task.
whole_frontend.source_stability: PlannerOverlay source and tests have remained unchanged since the run started. Original Codex diagram assets and their generator were updated during the first run; no identical whole-repository snapshot is claimed.

limitations: This proves a commit-before-passive-effects defect, not a captured trace tying every historical Escape or Close failure to this cause.
The separate useModalSheet Escape case remains unresolved.
No product UI, final Codex page acceptance, CI, PR, merge, publication or deployment result is established by these local tests.
